title: UserGoalAttestation
description: Professor's final attestation that the ORIGINAL user intake problem (not the reshaped academic claim) is now addressable with the evidence produced. Required as the second half of the dual publication gate alongside AC accept.

user_intake_recap.description: Professor recaps the user's ORIGINAL intake problem in their own words. Must reference deployment / decision context, not just the reshaped claim.

achieved.description: TRUE only when a practitioner reading the final paper could take it back to the user's desk and act on it tomorrow. FALSE if the user is still stuck even though some narrower academic claim was proved.

what_user_can_do_with_this_paper.description: Concrete procedure / decision rule / code path / threshold the user can apply. If achieved=false, this MUST honestly state what is still missing.

evidence_anchors_back_to_intake.description: At least two specific evidence anchors that bridge the paper's measurements to the user's intake problem. Single-anchor attestation is too thin to count as user-goal achievement.

required_additional_research.description: If achieved=false, must list >=1 concrete experiments needed to close the gap. If achieved=true, can be empty.

required_resources.description: ADR 0007 rev.2 (A2): resources this experiment needs, each CHECKED by the harness against the feasibility_envelope. The harness DERIVES attemptable_in_envelope from membership — the LLM cannot set that boolean. A declaration only RAISES the bar (names more needs); naming a resource that is actually present keeps the item attemptable, so a misdeclaration to dodge in-envelope work is caught.

ref.description: data_source: an envelope data_sources_available id (adapter_id / synthetic label). llm_oracle: an envelope llm_oracles_available kind (e.g. live_anthropic_api).

attemptable_in_envelope.description: ADR 0007 rev.2 (A2): HARNESS-STAMPED, not LLM-authored (the harness overwrites any submitted value). True iff every required_resource is present in the feasibility_envelope (absent/empty required_resources -> conservatively true). honest-failure is refused while any attemptable_in_envelope=true item is still undone — a give-up is not honest while in-envelope work remains; the system fans out instead.

synthetic_to_real_caveat.description: Optional but recommended. If the evidence is synthetic-only, explicitly state how it constrains conclusions about the user's real environment.

attested_status.description: Harness-STAMPED first-class status (not the bare achieved boolean), keyed to verdict_strength (ADR 0008). goal_achieved = transfer_valid (a real referent's falsifier passed — reality-close). construct_valid_screen = a funded construct-adversary failed to break the frozen question (Axis 1; strongest air-gapped terminal; necessary, NOT sufficient). unverified_screen = internally_valid floor (no funded adversary survived yet). not_achieved = a real referent is registered but its falsifier hasn't passed (retry). The gate derives it; the LLM does not assert it.

verdict_strength.description: ADR 0008: harness-DERIVED maximum verdict strength from the referent ledger. internally_valid (internal referent only) < construct_valid (funded construct-adversary survived the frozen question) < transfer_valid (a real referent's falsifier passed). A verdict above the available referent is unconstructable — the LLM cannot author this field.

referent_ledger.description: ADR 0008: the harness-computed ledger {has_real_referent, has_construct_referent, max_reachable_verdict} that produced verdict_strength. Recorded for audit.

load_bearing_mechanism.description: ADR 0007: for a weak/negative terminal, the EARNED conclusion — WHY the direction fails (or what would have to be true to succeed) and how that constrains the future. This is condition (a) of the depth gate; render_honest_failure_paper refuses a shallow give-up that has no mechanism. Not a limitations-section flourish: name the specific load-bearing assumption that broke and what its breakage predicts.

scope_attainment.description: ADR 0006 (incentive integrity): records narrowing relative to the frozen seed, so a claim that narrowed to win is visibly below a full-scope attempt rather than laundered into an indistinguishable accept.

seed_target_scope.description: feasibility_envelope.operator_intent.target_deploy_grade_scope — what the operator originally asked for.

attested_scope.description: The scope this attestation actually stands at.

narrowed.description: True when attested_scope is weaker than seed_target_scope. A narrowed=true win must rank below a full-scope honest attempt.

attemptability_audit.description: ADR 0007 rev.2 (A2): harness-stamped list of required-research items the run declared as needing an out-of-envelope resource (so they were classified NOT attemptable, exempting them from the honest-failure block). Surfaced for operator audit — the harness cannot verify air-gapped that the experiment truly needs the named absent resource.
